mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.background_url, u.signature, u.gender, u.birthday, u.level, u.exp, u.coin_balance, u.role, u.created_at, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS followed, COALESCE(s.video_count, 0) AS video_count, COALESCE(s.post_count, 0) AS post_count, COALESCE(s.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(s.follower_count, 0) AS follower_count, COALESCE(s.following_count, 0) AS following_count, COALESCE(s.like_received, 0) AS like_received, COALESCE(s.play_total, 0) AS play_total, COALESCE(s.coin_received, 0) AS coin_received FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_stats s ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_follow f ON f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS user_id, username, password_hash, role, status, deleted_at FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
